diagnosis: In FRAME_FIFO mode, drop_frame_reg should remain asserted across the full frame until s_axis_tlast is observed, but the current code unconditionally clears it each cycle (drop_frame_next defaults to 1'b0). Once the frame ends, wr_ptr_cur_reg must snap back to wr_ptr_reg to discard the partial frame, yet the reset path only clears wr_ptr_cur_reg without reloading it from wr_ptr_reg. Together these cause the FIFO to accept the tail of an overflowed frame as a new valid frame, so m_axis_tvalid stays asserted after the input stream ends.

ranking.mechanism: Retains drop_frame_reg instead of defaulting to 1'b0, keeping the drop state asserted until the frame's tlast arrives.
Requires s_axis_tready before evaluating full_cur/full_wr/drop_frame_reg, preventing spurious frame-drop decisions when the upstream is not ready.
Qualifies the !FRAME_FIFO branch with !full_wr, avoiding pointer updates that corrupt FRAME_FIFO state.
Gates the overflow/drop condition on s_axis_tlast so wr_ptr_cur_reg only rolls back at frame boundaries.
Adds !s_axis_tready to the USER_ENABLE condition, reducing write-side activity during back-pressure.
Resets wr_addr_reg on rst, ensuring the write address used in the same cycle as reset is clean.
